goal.original: Continue MPI-620: ship the Scribble flow - draw on a blank canvas, a model renders it.
goal.summary: The whole app half is built, tested and live-verified against an SDXL + ControlNet graph, and it works. But Fabio's side-by-side live runs showed edit models (Klein 9B/4B, Krea 2) beating the SDXL path decisively on the same drawing, so he has DECIDED the flow pivots to EDIT MODELS ONLY. The graph must be re-authored and the ControlNet controls stripped from the FlowDef. Nothing has been ripped out yet - the SDXL build is intact and green on disk.

completed: Recovered the SDXL+ControlNet graph from fe525d8e - the brief's premise was stale, MPI-621 had already deleted it from flow_draw_it_in.json. Copy preserved on the card as recovered_sdxl_graph.json.
Answered the brief's open question 1 in code: the canvas-size field lives on the PAINT STEP, because a step's own fields reach the gizmo as props.value AT MOUNT and a flow-level field never would.
Op flowScribble registered in all 4 files; FlowDef 'scribble' added with a five-card choosable slot, loras:true, modelParams, one optional image slot.

Frame made media-optional: _buildStepSlide and _deriveRunMedia both gated on the new step flag `composite`; stepKinds STEP_MEDIA now takes the step and branches paint between composePaintLayer and the new composePaintComposite.

MpiStepPaint: _initSurface extracted from the load handler (closing the silent 1x1 PNG trap), white ground when there is no source, el.onField, and a lossless re-canvas on size change backed by a _master layer.

Fixed 3 real bugs found along the way - onField reading a stale props.value, _urlDirty not set on reshape (would have stretched every reshaped drawing), and MpiDropdown pinning its portalled list to the trigger width so options ellipsised.
UI rework from Fabio's live look: fields moved beside the canvas via the new opt-in `fieldsSide` step flag, stage 46vh->68vh, prompt 180px.
Playbook gap closed: add-flow README now names all three unconditionally-emitted titles, not just Input_Positive.
npm test 738/738 and npm run test:desktop 26/26, both green at handoff.

Fabio runs the Krea 2 qualification test - it keeps rendering the drawn pink strokes as real objects, and it only stays in the model list if that can be stopped.
Strip Input_Control_Net and Input_Control_strength from the FlowDef, delete the drawing-type radio and follow-the-drawing slider, rewrite the step hint copy.

Bake the instruction prefix in an MpiText node the way Draw It In does, so the user types only the subject. Fabio's working prefix: 'Change the drawing to a realistic view with <subject>'; he noted it needs improving and that naming the camera angle mattered.
Rewrite the flow_scribble case in tests/inject-params-titles.test.cjs - it currently pins two AIO_Preprocessor arms, the two-switch wiring and input_control_*, all of which die with the ControlNet.
Decide the final model list for the slot, then wire modelParams per family.
Live run on the rebuilt flow, then /mpi-flow-graphics for the tile + hero.

next_action.description: Wait for Fabio's re-authored EDIT-MODEL graph and his Krea 2 verdict, then do the app-side pivot: strip the two ControlNet fields from the FlowDef, rewrite the flow_scribble case in tests/inject-params-titles.test.cjs, and set the model slot. Do NOT start by re-reading the code - the brief's SETTLED DESIGN section and the card's event log carry every decision.

key_decisions: EDIT MODELS ONLY (Fabio, 2026-08-26). Same drawing + same prompt through Klein 9B/4B and Krea 2 all placed the sea correctly; the three SDXL runs rendered the drawn strokes as physical white road barriers. He accepted that this retires SDXL scribble-to-image from the product, which was MPI-620's original stated purpose - a deliberate call, not drift.

Model list: Klein 9B/4B plus Boogu (boogu-edit-high / boogu-edit-balanced), and Krea 2 ONLY IF its leftover-line failure can be stopped. Fabio rates Krea the most realistic but it keeps rendering his pink dashes as real pink road paint.

Krea 2's leftover lines are very likely a PARAMETER, not the prompt: krea2_t2i_nsfw.json node 408 Krea2EditModelPatch ships ref_boost 2, which per docs/models/krea2/editing.md biases the WHOLE reference against the instruction and is tuned for identity preservation. Try 408 -> 1.0 first, then raise cfg (boost is weaker at cfg>1), and only then reword. Klein has no such patch, which is why it drops the strokes.

The ControlNet ceiling stays at output_max 0.5 and CEILING in flow-model-choice.test.cjs stays EMPTY. I argued for 0.6 mid-session and was WRONG - the live runs show over-following, not under-following. Moot once the ControlNet goes, but do not resurrect the argument.

Naming: flow id 'scribble', op 'flowScribble', workflow flow_scribble.json, gallery prefix FLOWSCRIBBLE_. Deliberately not reusing Draw It In's scribble-object / flowScribObj, which can never be freed because shipped gallery cards carry that prefix.
constraints: The FlowDef carries NO preview/video keys and must not until the art files exist - a name written ahead of the file 404s the tile, and three assertions in tests/desktop/flows-tab-ring.spec.js require consoleErrors to be empty. That is what held master's CI red for a day and eight pushes on Draw It In (7c883d67).

sync-raw-workflows.mjs REFUSES to run while a generated workflow is uncommitted, including the one the previous sync staged. The file is fully derived from raw, so the clean move is `git rm --cached` plus deleting it and letting the sync regenerate. NOT a throwaway commit, and NOT git stash (guard-git blocks it).

Killing an isolated app instance by its PORT OWNER leaves an Electron orphan holding the STABLE agent profile (os.tmpdir()/cubric-agent-profile), and the next launch then dies with splash ERR_FAILED (-2) plus 'Unable to move the cache'. Identify instances by the renderer's --user-data-dir, NEVER by name or age: both trees are the byte-identical 'electron.exe .' and Fabio's live app is usually one of them.

MpiBaseFlow cannot be measured by mounting into a detached div, and the shell's flow:open path gives a 0x0 overlay in the browser when no project is open. Mount into a throwaway div, then append inst.el into a position:fixed;inset:0 host sized 100%/100% - a display:flex host makes the whole flow shrink to content and every measurement reads far too small.

Synthetic PointerEvents never reach the paint brush (pointer capture rejects untrusted events). Test the layer through the REUSE path instead - mount with value.paint seeded and drive el.onField directly.

MPI-607's files.json still claims flowsRegistry.js, operationRegistry.js, operation_registry.json, universal_workflows.js and commandRegistry.js, but both its owner sessions are CLOSED with 2026-08-23 heartbeats against a 120-minute timeout, and its Voice Changer work already shipped. Treated as stale, not live.
